packet_finding_reviews.rationale: C103 2025-06-30. (a) Retirement: retire_check.py on data/output and nczc PASS (Cohnreznick undrawn line ROW-402e23d5ac7c9aa0 fair_value 0, cost -11,000, as printed '3,477 ( 11 ) - -'); four plants caught; ledger verdict_retired VR-FL-1911066-02, applied_by the investigator under D-252. Sound. (b) The 11 rows: read all 11 printed lines; each is an undrawn 'First Lien Debt (Delayed Draw)' or 'Revolving Loan' with bracketed fair value, cost a dash (PT Intermediate cost 1); published fair values equal the printed figures. C103 excludes rows whose issuer/instrument/identifier text names a revolver or delayed draw (_unfunded_position_sql); the older members carry the company name only, so the text was missing. Setting instrument_description to the printed instrument changes what C103 sees, but towards the page: the values are untouched and the rows are what C103 is designed to pass (sign-consistent unfunded marks). It is a real, page-backed data fix, not a check workaround. Caveats: (1) it is selective: 617 loan rows print 'Revolving' or 'Delayed Draw' and still publish no instrument text, so C103 will misfire again on any future undrawn line of the old member form (see rejected observation instrument-description-not-published-from-page); (2) VR-FL-1911066-02's reason text still says the 11 flags are 'handled by a check repair request'; no request exists (orchestrator_requests is empty) and they were handled by row correction. The record should be corrected.

observation_reviews.rationale: The gap is real and wider than stated, and 'left' is the wrong action under the fix-flag-propose standing rule. The observation scopes it to four quarters (2,060 of 2,077 rows). My scan of every nczc row against its printed line: 2,838 loan rows print a lien or tranche ('First Lien', 'Subordinated', 'Second Lien') and publish no instrument_description, across every quarter from 2023-03-31 to 2025-09-30 (e.g. 90 of 121 rows empty at 2023-03-31); 617 loan rows print 'Revolving' or 'Delayed Draw' with no instrument text; 612 of them (537 First Lien Term Loan (Delayed Draw), 26 Subordinated Debt (Delayed Draw), 49 Revolving Loan) also publish no instrument_type, so they are not identifiable as unfunded commitments. This is what made C103 misfire, and the 11-row correction does not stop recurrence. Needed: restate the scope, and either carry the printed instrument column through the wrapper (the page reader already maps every row to its line) or record why that cannot be done. The detector proposal itself is fine.
